text: When preparing a delicious meal, starting with onions and garlic is a great way to add depth and flavor. Onions are crucial in creating a savory base, known as the "mirepoix" in French cuisine, which forms the foundation of many hearty dishes. To start, finely chop the onions and garlic, then sauté them in oil until they become translucent and slightly caramelized. This process, known as "sweating, " enhances the natural sweetness of the onions and adds complexity to the dish. Garlic, added at the same time, complements the onions and onions add a pungent, aromatic element that elevates the overall taste of the meal.
